en.not_linux: Run this installer on the Linux host that runs the Frappe Docker stack.
en.backend_missing: Could not find a running Compose backend container. Set FRAPPE_BACKEND_CONTAINER to its container name.
en.backend_ambiguous: More than one running Compose backend was found. Set FRAPPE_BACKEND_CONTAINER to the intended container.
en.bad_compose_metadata: The running backend does not expose the Compose project metadata required by this installer.
en.compose_file_missing: A Compose file recorded by the running backend is missing.
en.env_missing: The Frappe Docker project .env file was not found.
en.env_invalid: CUSTOM_IMAGE, CUSTOM_TAG, and PULL_POLICY must be set in the Frappe Docker .env file.
en.pull_policy: PULL_POLICY must be 'never' or 'missing' so Compose uses the locally built image.
en.wrong_frappe_version: This package requires Frappe {0}; the running image has Frappe {1}.
en.image_missing: The current local Frappe image was not found.
en.wrong_architecture: The current image architecture is {0}; this package requires linux/amd64.
en.site_missing: No configured Frappe sites were found in the running backend.
en.bad_site_name: A site name contains unsupported characters; refusing to pass it to Bench.
en.noninteractive: Run the installer from an interactive terminal so you can confirm the deployment.
en.confirmation: This will back up each site, build a new image, recreate the Frappe app services, and install or migrate the app. Continue? [y/N]
en.backup_started: Creating site backups before changing the running stack...
en.backup_missing: Bench did not create a new backup for a site; the deployment has stopped.
en.build_started: Building the app image from the current local Frappe image...
en.maintenance_started: Enabling maintenance mode and installing the app on each site...
en.rollback: Deployment did not finish. Restoring the previous image setting and attempting to restart the previous app services. Database changes are not automatically reversed; backups are in {0}.
en.complete: Factory Management {0} is installed. The app services now use image {1}. Backups are in {2}.

vi.not_linux: Hãy chạy bộ cài trên máy Linux đang chạy stack Frappe Docker.

vi.compose_file_missing: Thiếu một tệp Compose được ghi nhận bởi backend đang chạy.
vi.env_missing: Không tìm thấy tệp .env của dự án Frappe Docker.
vi.env_invalid: Tệp .env của Frappe Docker phải có CUSTOM_IMAGE, CUSTOM_TAG và PULL_POLICY.

vi.bad_site_name: Tên một site có ký tự không được hỗ trợ; bộ cài dừng trước khi gọi Bench.

vi.confirmation: Bộ cài sẽ sao lưu từng site, tạo image mới, tạo lại các dịch vụ app Frappe và cài hoặc migrate app. Tiếp tục? [y/N]
